title: Information Theoretic Evaluation of Privacy-Leakage, Interpretability, and Transferability for Trustworthy AI
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally about creating a quantitative framework for 'Trustworthy AI' (TAI), which is explicitly defined by and motivated by established ethical principles such as beneficence, non-maleficence, autonomy, justice, and explicability. The entire work is an attempt to translate these ethical guidelines into measurable, information-theoretic quantities (privacy, interpretability, transferability). This goes far beyond a superficial 'Ethical Considerations' section, making the evaluation of systems against ethical principles a core component of the research.
